candidate_windows.window_text: Efficient inference is crucial for real-world deployment of UAV VLN, particularly in resourceconstrained edge environments. To assess the practicality of FlightGPT, we evaluated its memory usage and inference latency during the deployment phase and compared them with several representative VLMs. The results are summarized in Appendix E. On a single RTX 4090 GPU, FlightGPT exhibits an average latency of 9.37 seconds per step and memory usage of 21.71 GB. Compared with other VLMs,FlightGPT achieves relatively higher inference efficiency, which suggests strong potential for edge deployment.
